q: How many days do I have to return a book to Marginalia?
a: You can return a book to Marginalia within 14 days of delivery, as long as it is unread. Return postage is paid by the customer.

q: How long does a Marginalia refund take?
a: Marginalia refunds within ten working days of receiving the returned books.
Standard delivery at Marginalia is free on orders over 50.

q: Can I read Marginalia e-books on a Kindle?
a: Yes, Marginalia e-books can be sent to a Kindle from your library.

q: What is Marginalia's customer service phone number?
a: You can call Marginalia's customer service on 0800 555 0199, every day from 9 am to 6 pm.

q: What commission does a Marginalia affiliate earn?
a: Marginalia affiliates earn 5% on every purchase made through their links.

q: How much does a marketplace seller pay Marginalia?
a: Marketplace sellers pay Marginalia a commission of 10% of the item price.

q: How long are gift cards valid?
a: Marginalia gift cards are valid for one year from purchase.
Marginalia was founded in 2012 by two booksellers in Porto Alegre.
